prompt._raw_prompt: 英文：Create an aerial panoramic view of a charming town split by a bright turquoise river, with colorful European-style buildings lining the riverbanks, lush green mountains in the background, a clear blue sky with a few fluffy clouds, and sunlight sparkling on the water. 中文：绘制一幅被明亮青绿色河流分隔的迷人小镇航拍全景，河岸排列着色彩斑斓的欧式建筑，背景是葱郁青山，晴朗蓝天飘着几朵蓬松白云，阳光在水面闪烁。
